candidate.answerReason: At x=1, every power on the right is 1, so the requested coefficient sum equals (3−1)^7=128.

methods.label: Set x equal to one
methods.explanation:
To turn the polynomial into the sum of its coefficients, set \(x=1\). Every power of \(x\) then equals \(1\), so the given identity yields
\[
a_7+a_6+\cdots+a_0=(3\cdot1-1)^7=2^7=128.
\]
Thus the coefficient sum is \(128\), choice E.
methods.levelReason: Direct substitution and a small integer power suffice; expanding the seventh power is unnecessary.
